name: The Fay Enchantress
canonNotes: The most powerful Damsel of the Lady of the Lake, who dwells in Quenelles and speaks for the goddess.
Mysterious and ancient; guides knights on their Grail quests.
voiceNotes: Serene, enigmatic and otherworldly; speaks in gentle prophecy.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
